column1: # SFA1 arranged stage loops -- SATURN CD-DA coordinates (44.1 kHz).
# DERIVED from the ear-adjudicated 48 kHz Anthology coordinates
# in sfa1_arrange_loops.tsv (which remains the authoring provenance).  The
# Saturn arranged stage tracks are the SAME RECORDING as the Anthology
# arrange bank (waveform r >= +0.999 on all 13); per-track alignment
# measured at -662..-673 samples @44.1k (Saturn leads by ~15 ms, uniform)
# and level ratio 1.02-1.03 (trigger gain unchanged).  Transform per track:
#   ls44 = round(ls48 * 44100/48000) + offset, floored to the 32-sample ADX
# Seam equivalence vs the shipped 48k pack VERIFIED: each seam's
# pre- and post-halves render-match the shipped pack at r >= +0.979 (most
# +0.99x) with joint shift <= 0.98 ms -- sub-audible, so the original ear
# approvals carry over without a re-listen.
